integrity: A complete self-contained proof and a reproducible exact arithmetic regression accompany the claim. Self-review only; no independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only reciprocal justified representation with two seats, positive qualities at most one, and every candidate approved by someone. It does not claim other reciprocal axioms or larger committees. The asymptotic construction in the source paper already supplies the lower-bound idea; the new contribution is the universal finite-electorate upper bound and equality necessity. Equivalence with obscure prior formulations cannot be ruled out completely.
title: Exact finite-electorate quality price for two-seat reciprocal justified representation
